title: Operator touches per merged PR
definition: operator-decided decisions + class-O escalations + class-H items, divided by PRs merged

title: Unnecessary escalations
definition: escalations the operator answered with the default, of all escalations

title: Operator corrections per day
definition: operator messages that correct a session

title: Intent → merged, p90
definition: dispatch sent to its pull request merged, 90th percentile

title: Merged → released, p90
definition: pull request merged to the release that ships it, 90th percentile

title: Failed CI runs per merged PR
definition: failed CI runs divided by PRs merged

title: Idle controller hours
definition: hours a controller session waits with nothing dispatched

title: Waiting hours
definition: hours a session waits on the operator or a limit

title: Sessions lost to limits
definition: sessions ended by a usage or context limit

title: Guard denials per day
definition: guard decisions that denied a tool call, per day

title: Tokens per merged PR
definition: assistant output tokens per merged PR

title: Patch releases per feature release
definition: patch releases divided by feature releases

title: Tokens per task (in, out, cache)
definition: tokens a dispatched task spends, input, output and cache

title: Time per task
definition: dispatch sent to done, per task

title: Cost per task (list-price equivalent)
definition: a task's tokens at list price

title: LLM calls per task
definition: model calls a dispatched task makes
